note: Regional park on the south shore of Fife Lake, 9 km east of Rockglen on Highway 18 and 1 km north, with a sand beach and swimming area (no lifeguard), a concrete boat launch and dock, disc golf, ball diamonds, two playgrounds and an event quonset. A motocross track adjoins the campground, and the July long weekend brings mud-bog races and a beach cabaret. The lakeside row sits behind a dense shelterbelt above the beach. Site 18 is unlevel and posted as hard going for rigs over about 26 ft. --Claude
summary: Keep (local, nearly all nightly). SRP page: 39 x 30 A + 8 x 15 A (all with water) + 14 tent = 61 sites; Let's Camp sells 64 nightly (max 50 ft). Fees $20 unserviced / $35 power+water, entry $5/day; Let's Camp online booking. Hookups, sites, facilities, fees and booking written. WATERFRONT: lakeview -> not waterfront recommended (shore row 55-70 m from the water behind a dense shelterbelt, no site photo shows the lake). Google 4.3 (16). Pin between the two site groups, OK.
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD (downgrade): stored 'lakeview' -> 'not waterfront' recommended. The only rows near Fife Lake are the lakeside row on Credit Union Way (Let's Camp map sites 17-37: 30 A sites 17-25 nightly, unserviced 26-37 nightly). On Esri imagery the RVs in that row (e.g. ~49.19872,-105.85507 and ~49.19897,-105.85402) sit 55-70 m from the water's edge, with a continuous belt of trees ~15-20 m deep and then a grassed bank between; the camp's own drone photo shows the belt as an unbroken wall of trees along the bank. No site photo exists (Let's Camp sites have no gallery) and none of the park photos is taken from a site. The south rows (99-128, near the gate) are ~350 m from the lake. Under the 'unsure goes down' rule this is not waterfront; a reviewer who accepts a view over a shelterbelt from the bank top could keep lakeview, but nothing shows the lake from a site.

LONG-STAY (local): nightly share high. Let's Camp sells 64 sites by the night (40 x 30 A, 5 x 15 A, 19 unserviced; only site 24 is also typed Seasonal) and has seasonal public booking switched off; SRP lists 47 electric sites, so at most ~2 electric sites are held off the engine. A seasonal rate ($1,000) and monthly rate ($700) are posted, but nothing discourages nightly guests. Not mostly seasonal. Google Maps 'Rockin Beach Park' 4.3 (16 reviews).

OHV (flag only, general campground): the SRP page lists 'A motor cross track' among the park's offerings, the Let's Camp map shows the 'Motocross Track' in the field east of the reunion overflow, and 'July long weekend is a particularly busy time with mud bog races'. The track is a feature beside an ordinary lakeside campground, not a staging camp - keep, reviewer may want the note line.

SITES: no count was stored -> 61 per the SRP page; Let's Camp catalog has 64 (40 x 30 A, 5 x 15 A, 19 'No power') - SRP's 8 x 15 A / 14 tent vs Let's Camp 5 / 19 differ. max_rig 50 ft (Let's Camp). Site 18's description: 'WARNING[seven exclamation marks] 26-33 foot and bigger campers will have difficulties due to lot being unlevel' (max 32); site 100 max 32 ft. A 23-ft rig fits every site.

HOOKUPS: new - 30 A max, water at the serviced sites (SRP: '30-amp (water and electric)', '15-amp (water and electric)'; Let's Camp marks the 15 A sites without water), no sewer anywhere (dump station).

FEES: nightly_low C$20 is the unserviced site SRP calls 'Tenting no power'; Let's Camp offers all 19 of them to RVs (max 49-50 ft). If the reviewer prefers the powered base, nightly_low would be C$35. Prices undated on the page ('prices subject to change without notice'); the page is the 2026 SRP site. Taxes not stated. Let's Camp's refund policy mentions a 'set reservation fee' without an amount - not written.
SEASON: not written - SRP page and 2026 guide say only 'Mid-May to mid-September'.
BOOKING: Let's Camp live (allowOnlineBookings true, minNights 1, check-in 3 pm / out 11 am). fcfs not stated.

PIN: stored 49.19700,-105.85590 sits in the open field between the reunion overflow loop and the beach road, ~150-250 m from both site groups (lakeside row centred ~49.1983,-105.8553; south rows by the gate near the Highway access). Not over 250 m from the nearest sites; no move proposed. SRP/Let's Camp point 49.19534,-105.85728 is near the gate.
